extraction.Name: Jesse Ellston
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded October 1, 1918 but the records do not show by whom
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged and sold; on Sept. 28, 1918 the land was mortgaged for $1500.00; again on February 1, 1924 it was mortgaged for $3500.00; then by deed dated February 28, 1925 for $1.00, love and affection, the land was conveyed to Fannie Ellston
extraction.Buyer: Conveyed to Fannie Ellston for $1.00, love and affection, by deed dated February 28, 1925
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612808 issued; Southeast quarter of section 14, township 95, range 71; receipt for patent signed by allottee February 14, 1918; document dated 1929
